title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction
summary: An end-to-end machine learning project that predicts telecom customer churn from the IBM Telco dataset, with training, a FastAPI service, and a Streamlit UI deployed via Docker. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is run via ml/generate_synthetic.py to fit on the training data and generate batches of synthetic rows for data augmentation.
